summary.text: Micah Lasher was elected to the New York State Assembly in 2024 and represents a district on Manhattan's West Side.
His official biography says he previously served as Director of Policy for the State of New York, Chief of Staff to the New York State Attorney General and an aide to Congressman Jerry Nadler.

paragraphs.text: According to his Assembly biography, Lasher has lived on the West Side his whole life and grew up ten blocks from where he lives now on the Upper West Side with his wife, Elizabeth, and their three children.
Before the Assembly he also served as Director of State Legislative Affairs for the City of New York.

The biography says he helped write gun safety laws after the Buffalo and Uvalde shootings, legislation protecting abortion providers and patients, a minimum wage indexed to inflation, a statewide all-electric buildings law, and a $1 billion mental health plan.
He served on the board of the Riverside Park Conservancy for ten years, as chair from 2019 to 2024, and was on the boards of Everytown and the Community Service Society, where he was vice chair.
